messages:
Maya R: heads up — planning to enforce stricter org->project RBAC next week. Need to confirm KMS access bindings & audit logging behavior. Who's owning the migration plan? :thinking_face:
Alex W: I'm on it. main risk is service accounts that currently have cross-project read via the legacy `project.viewer` binding.
Liam C: quick flag — if we change the evaluation to require `resource.scope == org` for org roles, automation that assumes project-level access will break. We should dry-run first.
Alex W: here's the naive policy change I'm testing:
```json
{
  "bindings": [
    {"role":"org.admin","condition":"resource.type==\"org\""},
    {"role":"project.viewer","condition":"resource.scope==\"project\""}
  ]
}
```
audit-bot: Detected 112 principals with elevated org roles in last 30d. CSV export: https://internal.redwood/audit/elevated_principals_112.csv
Maya R: ok can someone run a dry-run to list SAs that will lose `kms:decrypt`? Command: `rbac-tool simulate --policy new --out affected.csv`
Jamie L: running now. ETA ~15m.
Jamie L: results: 87 service accounts affected, 3 customer-owned keys might be impacted. Uploading `affected.csv` to the ticket. Recommendation: create project-scoped KMS aliases and grant `kms.decrypt` for alias principals.
Liam C: note for Private deployments — KMS is customer-managed. We must NOT auto-update customer key bindings. Add an exception list and manual approval step.
Alex W: agreed. Also need a log schema tweak: tag `actor.scope` in audit logs so we can filter org-initiated changes vs project-level. SRE + Security to sign off.
Maya R: action items: (1) Alex update migration runbook with dry-run and rollback, (2) Jamie produce `affected.csv` + exception list, (3) Liam validate private-deploy behavior & exceptions. Target: canary policy deploy to non-prod next Tue.
sec-bot: Created SEC ticket SEC-2026 and linked runbook. https://go/SEC-2026
Liam C: :eyes: please include a rollback command in the runbook, e.g. `rbac-tool rollback --snapshot snapshot-206789`
Jamie L: added rollback steps and a smoke test for `kms.decrypt` on a sample SA.
Alex W: I'll coordinate canary and wire up monitors for `auth.fail_rate` and `audit.missing_kms`. Will post dashboards in this thread.
Maya R: thanks all :raised_hands: cc @Lucia G from Legal — can you confirm retention/compliance for pre-change audit snapshots?
Lucia G: short answer — yes. Please keep pre-change audit snapshot for 6 months and ensure logs are immutable during the window. If any customer keys are involved, include consent notes in the ticket.
Maya R: perfect. I'll iterate the runbook and tag folks when ready for review.
Alex W: pinging on-call SRE to advise on load impact during the canary.
SRE Oncall: noted, will monitor and stand by for rollback.
Maya R: thanks — ending run of notes here, will follow up with a formal PR to the policy repo and attach `affected.csv`.
